retainedNegativeResults.claimRejected: The initial Foundation directory enumerator and blob-only recovery were sufficient to clean durable manifest temporary files after process exit.
retainedNegativeResults.correction: Add a POSIX bounded directory reader that includes hidden entries, invoke root temporary cleanup before blob reconciliation, and retain the exact two failing points in the process crash matrix.
retainedNegativeResults.counterexample: The first 11-point process crash run failed after manifest data write and file fsync because a hidden root .durable-tmp file remained after reopen.

retainedNegativeResults.claimRejected: A flat crash-safe manifest has negligible application-layer write amplification for small total payloads.
retainedNegativeResults.correction: Keep the correctness-first implementation but retain the small-object workload and evaluate batching, segmentation or append-plus-checkpoint designs only if all crash, recovery, schema and partition obligations continue to pass.
retainedNegativeResults.counterexample: The retained 64 by 4 KiB workload rewrote 734,874 manifest bytes for 262,144 payload bytes, yielding an approximately 3.8033 times total logical write upper bound; the 8 by 1 MiB workload was approximately 1.0016 times.
